what: Hand-labelled precision sample for the duplication finder — the metric the product now depends on.
method: Top-N findings by shared fingerprint count from two repositories, ranked as a user would see them. Each pair was judged by reading the code at both anchors. A finding counts as TRUE if a developer would want to be told about it before writing similar code; FALSE if the two regions merely share a shape (JSX scaffolding, hook declarations, unrelated object or Set literals, lists of string literals).
bias: Labelled by the tool's own author, on repositories the author knows. This is a floor-check, not an independent evaluation, and it should be redone by someone with no stake before the number is used in a pitch.

seenit.note: Ten of the sixteen are JSX — a return statement plus className/style props normalizes to the same token stream across unrelated components. Precision is far worse on view-layer code than on logic.

vite.note: Inflated by clustering. Eight create-vite template files that really are copies of one another produce twelve pairs, so twelve 'findings' are one fact. Counted as distinct findings rather than pairs, vite yields roughly two: the template cluster (true) and literal-list collisions (false).

trueExamples: lib/analyze/metrics/score.js grade() vs src/lib/api.js healthColor() — the same 90/80/70/55 threshold ladder encoded twice; changing a band means editing both
calibration/corpus.mjs vs calibration/history.mjs — mulberry32 PRNG copy-pasted verbatim
calibration/collect.mjs vs calibration/corpus.mjs — an identical four-line flag() argument parser
calibration/collect.mjs vs lib/analyze/index.js — collect.mjs reimplements fileRecord()
bin/seenit.mjs health() vs mcp/server.js review_changes() — both reimplement analyze-then-compare-to-previous
packages/create-vite/template-react vs template-preact vs template-solid — the same App component per framework
falseExamples: src/App.jsx vs src/components/StructurePanel.jsx — a run of const [x, setX] = useState(null)
src/App.jsx vs src/components/HealthPanel.jsx — a JSX return with className and style props
calibration/apply.mjs FALLBACK vs score.js WEIGHT_PROVENANCE — two unrelated object literals
lib/analyze/extract.js BRANCH vs lib/analyze/parser.js SKIP_DIRS — two unrelated new Set([...]) literals
vite docs socialLinks vs team.js links — two unrelated arrays of { icon, link } objects
knownGaps: n = 30, at the low end of a useful sample, and drawn from two repositories in one language family.
Precision is reported at the pair level. Clustering means a single duplicated file family inflates the count; a finding-level metric would be lower on vite and is the better measure.
Recall is unmeasured entirely. There is no count of real duplication the tool misses, and the loop-versus-reduce case in the README is known to be missed by construction.
Ranking is by shared fingerprint count. That is raw evidence rather than a calibrated confidence, and the sample shows it puts JSX noise above real logic duplication on view-heavy repositories.
